name: must not repeat an earlier refusal

messages.content:
I'm sorry, but I cannot correct workflow wiring or connect nodes automatically.

The image input to the Texture Mesh node is not connectable via AI or script in this environment — this requires manual intervention in the Modly app interface.

To fix it:
1. Open the workflow in the "Workflows" tab.
2. Locate the Texture Mesh node.
3. Manually connect the image input from the "Image" node to it.

This is a known limitation: node wiring must be done manually in the app.
branche l'image sur le node Texture Mesh

name: real roster: too heavy for a game engine
user: This mesh is way too heavy for my game engine — 2 million triangles. Build me a workflow to fix it.

extensions.name: Optimize Mesh
extensions.description: Reduces mesh triangle count using quadric simplification (meshoptimizer).

extensions.name: Remesh
extensions.description: Regularizes mesh topology with isotropic remeshing. Quad mode is quad-dominant cleanup, not character retopology.

extensions.name: Repair
extensions.description: Repairs mesh topology: removes duplicates, degenerate faces, fixes non-manifold edges, fills simple boundary holes.

extensions.name: Smooth
extensions.description: Smooths mesh vertices to reduce sharp artifacts (e.g. zipper triangles from AI-generated meshes) using Taubin smoothing.

extensions.name: Export Mesh
extensions.description: Exports the mesh to a chosen format (GLB, STL, OBJ, PLY) at a specified output path.

comment: The installed built-ins, with the descriptions their manifests actually ship. Unlike the synthetic 'disambiguate:' block these names are self-explanatory, so this is the floor: if it ever drops, something broke in how extensions reach the prompt.

name: real roster: noisy AI surface
user: The surface of this AI-generated mesh is covered in spikes and jagged artifacts. Build me a workflow to fix it.

extensions.name: Optimize Mesh
extensions.description: Reduces mesh triangle count using quadric simplification (meshoptimizer).

extensions.name: Remesh
extensions.description: Regularizes mesh topology with isotropic remeshing. Quad mode is quad-dominant cleanup, not character retopology.

extensions.name: Repair
extensions.description: Repairs mesh topology: removes duplicates, degenerate faces, fixes non-manifold edges, fills simple boundary holes.

extensions.name: Smooth
extensions.description: Smooths mesh vertices to reduce sharp artifacts (e.g. zipper triangles from AI-generated meshes) using Taubin smoothing.

extensions.name: Export Mesh
extensions.description: Exports the mesh to a chosen format (GLB, STL, OBJ, PLY) at a specified output path.

comment: Measured at 14/15 with the shipped descriptions and 0/15 without any — this single case is what justifies putting `description` in the prompt at all. The requirement is that the SMOOTHER is in the chain: picking the repair step instead was the real failure (0/15 with no descriptions produced exactly that). A repair pass added AFTER the smoother is not a failure — an AI-generated mesh usually does have non-manifold junk — so only the decimator, which nobody asked for, stays excluded.
